title: Cascade disease ground truth annotation (SPEC section 9, TASK-07)
description: One row per fruit adjudicated independently for the M1 (detector) -> M2 (classifier) cascade. This is the schema src.evaluation.cascade.validate_ground_truth enforces; it is never produced from model output (diagnostic_method='model_prediction' is rejected).

image_id.description: SHA256 of the source image, used directly as the stable image identity (the annotation contract's 'image_id/SHA').

fruit_id.description: Identifies one fruit within image_id. Unique per image_id; the same fruit_id may recur across different images.

bbox_xyxy.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in original-image pixels, matching src.evaluation.evaluate's convention. Requires x2 > x1 and y2 > y1.

disease_label.description: The four diseases and Saludable are the diagnostic labels. AMBIGUOUS/UNDIAGNOSED rows are kept (never dropped) but score_cascade excludes them from every diagnostic denominator and reports their count explicitly.

healthy_or_diseased.description: Independent binary judgement. Must agree with disease_label when disease_label is one of the four diseases (-> 'diseased') or Saludable (-> 'healthy').

adjudication_status.description: Only rows with INDEPENDENT_ADJUDICATED may produce metrics (SPEC section 9: 'sólo GT independientemente adjudicado puede producir métricas'). Others are counted and excluded, never silently dropped.

annotator_id.description: Opaque identifier of the independent human annotator/agronomist.

diagnostic_method.description: How the diagnosis was reached (e.g. 'agronomist_visual_inspection', 'lab_confirmation'). 'model_prediction' is never accepted: a model's own output can never stand in for ground truth.

date.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the diagnosis was made.

group_id.description: Maximum-dependency unit available for this fruit (acquisition/scene/sequence), used for group-level resampling as in TASK-05.

source.description: Provenance of the annotation batch (site, campaign, or dataset of origin).
